mandatory_legal_checks: Contract Act 1872 S.124 — contract of indemnity; S.125 — the rights of the indemnity-holder when sued
The indemnified risk must be described precisely; an indemnity against everything indemnifies against nothing
Indian Stamp Act 1899 Schedule I Article 34 — stamp duty on an indemnity bond is a STATE subject and the rate varies; confirm the rate and whether registration is required
Contract Act 1872 S.25 — the recital must show the consideration, or the bond risks being a bare promise
Check the expiry outlasts the risk — an indemnity that expires before the liability can crystallise is worthless
